status: shipped: registered in PNG_UNIT_SPRITES and exported with strips.py export (#1627); the second, chestnut-coated set
generator: ChatGPT image generation (project owner, paid plan)
prompts: Generated from scripts/sprite-puppet/strip-rigs/horseman.json by `strips.py prompt` (templates in scripts/sprite-puppet/strip-prompts/), after the spec changed the horse from dapple-grey to a warm orange-brown chestnut (hue above the team-colour key). licence_note: Covered by the project's non-commercial posture (docs/asset-rights-ledger.md). This art ships in the game; it is counted in the ledger family 'ChatGPT image generation (unit strips)' and this record is its provenance.
originals_note: The downloaded originals are not committed (kept by the owner under ~/conquestoria-art-originals/strips/horseman-chestnut). Only the re-encoded sheet.png and mask.png are, built by scripts/sprite-puppet/strips.py from decoded pixels (no EXIF/XMP/ICC or C2PA survives).
scan: python3 -I scripts/portrait-pixelate/portrait_pixelate.py scan: all five passed (PNG magic bytes, nothing after the image stream, one frame, within the pixel limit). ClamAV was not installed, so only the structural checks ran.
regenerations: None recorded. `strips.py probe` reported 0 errors and 3 warnings (the attack, hit and defeat figures are about 230 px tall, under the tool's 300 px advice; the game draws the unit about 150 px tall). The coat measures hue 0.053-0.086 (the team-colour key ends at 0.045) and 10.7-12.9% of each image sits in the key.
extraction_note: Images c, d and e were supplied as separate transparent PNGs cut from ChatGPT's combined 1536 x 1024 combat sheet (combined_original below); how they were cut out was not recorded.

superseded_dapple_grey_set.note: The first Horseman set (2026-10-30 to 2026-10-31, a dapple-grey horse) was replaced because the owner preferred a chestnut coat. Its originals are kept by the owner under ~/conquestoria-art-originals/strips/horseman; its sheet is in git history.
